content: Summarise what changed for the reports page.

The rollup a report reads is now cached per account and dropped by the writer whenever a row for that account lands, so a report never reads a stale total.

The events table carries an index on the account column, which brings a cold read down from 11.8 seconds to 1.4.

Together, a first open after a write takes 1.4 seconds and every open after it about a quarter of a second.
